transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I suppose… it’s about spiders. I’ve been arranging things at home so I don’t have to see them—putting off laundry in the basement, not going into the garden shed. I’ve even paid people to do small jobs I should be able to do myself, just so I don’t have to go into those places.
When you encounter a spider or even think about one, does it cause immediate anxiety or a panic reaction, like a racing heart, sweating, or feeling very shaky?
Yes… if I see one, it happens straight away. My chest tightens, my hands start shaking, and I sort of freeze—or I’m already backing out before I’ve really thought about it.
